presentation-hero.goal: Create a full-bleed hero visual for an executive incident review deck.

subject.details: credible operational environment, not sci-fi, premium but realistic

scene.environment: security operations center with layered displays and subtle architectural depth

composition.safe_zones: clean negative space on the left for title and subtitle

style.color_direction: deep neutrals with restrained blue highlights

constraints: keep the image presentation-friendly and text-overlay safe

section-divider.goal: Generate section divider art for a security operations presentation.

subject.details: layered network geometry and infrastructure motifs

composition.safe_zones: empty space near the top for a large section headline

constraints: avoid visual noise behind potential headline text

ui-mockup.goal: Create a landing-page hero mockup for an enterprise SaaS product.

subject.details: believable information architecture and product-grade polish

composition.safe_zones: support adjacent marketing copy if cropped

style.color_direction: dark-on-light contrast with restrained accent colors

constraints: keep charts and layout coherent at first glance
